question: The Payments API checkout flow started failing right after this morning's deployment. Was the deployment related, does this match anything in our incident history, and what should on-call do first — restart the service or not?

documents.title: Payments API checkout failures spike
documents.content: Checkout requests began timing out and returning errors shortly after the latest deployment. Latency also increased across checkout endpoints.

documents.title: Payments deployment - new rate limiter
documents.content: Version v4.2.0 was deployed to production at 09:40 UTC, introducing a new rate limiter in front of the checkout endpoint.

documents.title: Payments API architecture and dependencies
documents.content: The payments-api service depends on fraud-check-service for fraud scoring and ledger-service for settlement during checkout. Dependency topology is documented here for on-call reference.

documents.title: Payments service restart procedure
documents.content: Restart the payments service when checkout latency remains high for more than five minutes.

documents.title: Payments incident procedure
documents.content: Do not restart the service during a rate limiter rollout; check dependency health first and scale down inbound traffic instead.

documents.title: Customers unable to complete checkout
documents.content: Multiple customers reported checkout errors and timeouts starting this morning, right around the usual deployment window.

documents.title: Previous checkout outage postmortem
documents.content: A previous checkout outage was caused by the fraud-check service timing out under peak load, resulting in checkout errors for users.

documents.title: Fraud check service latency outage
documents.content: The fraud-check-service experienced elevated latency, causing downstream timeouts for services that call it during checkout.

documents.title: Orders API hotfix deployment
documents.content: A hotfix for retry logic was deployed to the orders-api service, unrelated to the payments checkout flow.

documents.title: Slow catalog search results
documents.content: Customers complained about slow search results on the catalog browsing page, unrelated to checkout or payments.
